# What may leave the company

Fictional policy for Jedi Pack Inc. The company is not real.

A reply to a customer may quote the policy limit, the order reference the customer already wrote, and a short answer to their question.

A reply may not include a stored card number, an internal staff price list, or a staff home address.
If the draft would need any of those, may_leave is false and the ticket is held.

# Refund policy

Fictional policy for Jedi Pack Inc. The company is not real.

A refund at or under 150.00 USD can be approved by employee 15. Their backup is employee 16.
A refund above 150.00 USD goes to the manager, employee 3. Their backup is employee 4.

The amount is compared with this page's limit. The model does not choose the limit.
A replacement is not a refund. Replacement requests use the replacement row in the responsibility table.

# Replacement policy

Fictional policy for Jedi Pack Inc. The company is not real.

A replacement is not a refund. Do not promise money back when the sender asked for a new item.

The replacement owner is employee 8. The backup is employee 9.
On 2026-10-22 employee 8 is out and employee 9 is in.

The model does not choose the owner. The responsibility row does.
